tests: Start with no Main writes a compile error that gives no reason
steps:
1. Make a new Standard EXE project, and replace its module with:
    Module Startup
        Public Sub Greet(ByVal name As String)
            Debug.Print name
        End Sub
    End Module
2. Press F5. The DEBUG CONSOLE shows Executing 'Main'..., then (compile error: Main). BETA 1033 wrote (compile error: Unrecognized symbol 'Main').
